claims.claim: The Amazon rainforest is a type of tropical rainforest, characterized by a closed and continuous tree canopy, with moisture-dependent vegetation, and a diverse array of plant and animal species.
claims.quote: Tropical rainforests are characterized by a warm and wet climate usually with no substantial dry season

claims.claim: It has a warm and wet climate, with no substantial dry season, and plays a significant role in mitigating global warming.
claims.quote: Tropical rainforests are characterized by a warm and wet climate usually with no substantial dry season

claims.claim: The Amazon rainforest has seen a surge in fires, which can be devastating to the ecosystem, with over 80,000 fires reported in 2019, a 77% increase from the previous year.
claims.quote: As of August 29, 2019, INPE reported more than 80,000 fires across all of Brazil, a 77% year-to-year increase for the same tracking period

claims.claim: Fires normally occur around the dry season as slash-and-burn methods are used to clear the forest, leading to deforestation and habitat loss.
claims.evidence: Causes of fires in the Amazon rainforest
claims.quote: Fires normally occur around the dry season as slash-and-burn methods are used to clear the forest, leading to deforestation of the Amazon rainforest

claims.claim: The fate of the Amazon rainforest is a concern, as it is estimated that over 40% of all biotic species are indigenous to the rainforests, and the loss of this ecosystem could have severe consequences for the environment.
claims.quote: Estimates vary from 40% to 75% of all biotic species being indigenous to the rainforests

claims.claim: The Amazon rainforest is a moist broadleaf tropical rainforest, spanning over 7 million km2, and is home to many species of plants, insects, and microorganisms, making it a significant source of natural medicines.
claims.quote: The Amazon rainforest, also called the Amazon jungle, Amazonia, or simply the Amazon, is a moist broadleaf tropical rainforest in the Amazon biome that covers most of the Amazon basin of South America

claims.claim: The conservation of the Amazon rainforest is crucial, and efforts are being made to protect this vital ecosystem.
claims.evidence: Importance of conserving the Amazon rainforest
claims.quote: The conservation of the Amazon rainforest is crucial
